Both peer and self wraps with exact decoded operation/commitment/context equality

wholeRunContributionRule: A future v3 incoming cell is eligible only after whole-run qualification/current typed lineage and independent actual reviews; one incoming cell alone is insufficient. No failed run donates early rows.

oldEightProfile.declaredContract: eight cells and eight distinct qualifying runs
oldEightProfile.acceptedEvidence: synthetic DATA28 only; no new actual execution or completeness claim

adoption.condition: Actual same-subject independent QA/security confirm all canonical and actually adopted criteria/gates unchanged; explicit criterion-preserving adoption record.
adoption.otherwise: Specific separate Product Owner decision before changing any actually adopted mandatory scope/gate; no silent waiver from delegated routine authority.
